answer: Make identity expensive to grow and cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a deposit that only unlocks after a long season of honest work, like an orchard that takes years to bear fruit — a flood of fake accounts cannot fake time. Then let peers cross-check behavior the way a river tests every bank it passes: graders compare verdicts against the settled record, and accounts that keep diverging lose stake and seat. Keep the rules cold and public, a tundra where nothing hides, so a sybil ring cannot quietly buy in without the whole network seeing the pattern.
